blocks.text: Canyon Springs homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Canyon Springs, September 2026. Detached houses: 10 listed at month end and 1 sold in September, a sales ratio of 10% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 21 listed at month end and 5 sold in September, a sales ratio of 24% (a sellers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 5 sold over 4 months against an average of 10.5 listed, about 8.4 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 3 sold. Condos and townhomes: 18 sold over 4 months against an average of 20.8 listed, about 4.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 6 sold.

faq.q: Which school district and schools serve Canyon Springs?
faq.a: School District 43 (Coquitlam). For the sample address 1420 Pinetree Way, the SD43 locator result is Pinetree Way Elementary, Summit Middle and Pinetree Secondary; catchments are address-based, so check the exact address in the locator.

faq.q: What sold in Canyon Springs in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached: 1 sold from 10 listings (10% sales ratio); condos & townhomes: 5 solds from 21 listings (24%). At the Coquitlam community level the detached median sale price was $1,455,000 and the condos & townhomes median was $625,000 (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Can a Canyon Springs house lot add units?
faq.a: Yes under the City's SSMUH rules — up to 3 units on lots 280 m² or smaller and up to 4 units on lots larger than 280 m² and under 4,050 m², including secondary suites and carriage or laneway homes, where the zoning and municipal services allow.

faq.q: Which SkyTrain stations serve the area?
faq.a: Lincoln and Lafarge Lake-Douglas (Millennium Line, Evergreen Extension) on Pinetree Way are the nearest stations named in City Transit-Oriented Areas documents, and Coquitlam Central also has West Coast Express service.
